summary.text: Philip Cortez is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 117 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously held the seat from 2013 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Philip Cortez earned a B.S. in political science and an M.S. in public administration from the University of Texas at San Antonio in 2002 and 2007, and a Ph.D. in educational administration and leadership from the University of Texas at Austin in 2017.
Cortez served in the Texas House from 2013 to 2015 and assumed office again in 2017.
In 2021 and 2022 he chaired the Urban Affairs Committee, and in 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the Insurance Committee and the Urban Affairs Committee.
